content: {"praised":["Interesting take on Greek legend, entertaining comedy.","Beautiful women and dance sequences reminiscent of School Daze.","Spike Lee fearless, forces self-reflection on good and bad.","Greek theatrical style with rhyming dialogue adds unique flair.","Nick Cannon delivers strong performance, stepping out of clean‑cut image."],"criticized":["Silliness and ridiculous scenes make it a waste of time.","Insensitive satire on Chicago violence, disrespectful to victims.","Women portrayed only for sex, lacking intelligence.","Rhyming sentences create horrible dialogue, poor pacing.","Nick Cannon as thug feels out of place, unconvincing."]}
